items.title: Meta Ads: $99.78 spend, 8 leads, $12.47 CPL — Flooring Problems Campaign
items.summary: The most recent prior meta-ads.json (2026-09-02) covered spend through 2026-09-01, so this run widened from the standard --days 1 to --days 2 (2026-09-02 through 2026-09-03) to close the gap. Over that window Meta spent $99.78, all on the only actively-delivering campaign, Flooring Problems Campaign, generating 8 leads at $12.47 CPL. CPL is well below the 7-day baseline (2026-08-28 to 2026-09-03: $350.68 / 20 leads, ~$17.53 CPL); account is ACTIVE and no ads are flagged.

needs_attention: Window widened: the most recent prior meta-ads.json was 2026-09-02, covering spend through 2026-09-01. Per policy this run widened from the standard yesterday-only pull to 2 days (2026-09-02 through 2026-09-03) to cover the gap, rather than missing 2026-09-02 entirely.

Flooring Problems Campaign's raw actions again include lead-like conversion types outside the script's documented LEAD_ACTION_TYPES set (offsite_complete_registration_add_meta_leads, offsite_search_add_meta_leads, offsite_content_view_add_meta_leads — each valued at 8 in this window, 20 in the 7-day baseline, matching the counted leads exactly both times, same as flagged on 2026-08-31 and 2026-09-02). No discrepancy in the counted total so far, but this recurrence (now 3 runs running) suggests the script's lead-action set should be reviewed for extension rather than continuing to hand-note it each run.
